domain.name: Healthcare
domain.rationale: Detected healthcare signals from the target URL and release intent.

intents.title: Validate patient registration and profile creation
intents.rationale: Patient identity and demographics must be captured correctly before clinical workflows can proceed.
acceptanceCriteria: Patient can submit required demographic details.
Profile is created without exposing sensitive health data.

intents.title: Validate appointment booking and confirmation
intents.rationale: Appointment scheduling is the core healthcare access flow and a release blocker.
acceptanceCriteria: Patient can select provider, date, and slot.
Appointment confirmation is shown with correct details.

intents.title: Validate medical record access controls
intents.rationale: Protected health information needs clear access boundaries and audit-friendly behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Unauthorized or missing context does not expose records.

intents.title: Validate prescription or care instruction visibility
intents.rationale: Medication and care instructions have direct patient-safety impact.
acceptanceCriteria: Prescription details are visible after the correct workflow.
Instructions are readable and tied to the right patient.

intents.title: Validate consent and privacy messaging
intents.rationale: Consent and privacy clarity are key governance controls in healthcare apps.
acceptanceCriteria: Consent language is presented before sensitive action.
User can accept or decline with clear status.

intents.title: Validate accessibility for patient onboarding
intents.rationale: Healthcare journeys must be usable by patients with varied accessibility needs.
